title: queue start and done leave a newcomer stuck
what: queue start has a default scratch folder under $RELAY_HOME and says where it wrote the brief; queue done's refusal says a fix closes with a regression test that fails without the fix and names the form; queue drop says what the TOML holds in one line with an example.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. `relay queue start <slug>` without --scratch prints only the usage line (rc 2) and has no default folder; its JSON names kind 'change' for a fix item. `relay queue done <slug> -C <wt> --test tests/test_x.py::test_a` in a project with no tests refuses ('not in the last commit') with no hint that a fix needs a real regression test, and `queue drop` needs a TOML with the owner's words, so a trial item cannot be dismissed from a plain terminal.
failing_case: `relay queue start <slug>` with no --scratch exits 2 with only the usage line.
pass_cases: queue start without --scratch writes the brief under $RELAY_HOME and prints the path
queue done's refusal names the regression-test rule
queue drop's refusal shows a one-line TOML example
